summary: We developed an interactive space mission design and simulation game inspired by NASA’s Mars 2020 mission, enhanced with Augmented Reality (AR). Acting as mission leads, players choose a landing site, rover platform (Perseverance, Curiosity, or MER-class), science instruments, flight trajectory, and launch vehicle (such as Atlas V, Delta IV, or SLS) while balancing strict engineering constraints—budget, mass, power, communications, and reliability. Players then launch a simulation of liftoff, interplanetary cruise, landing, and surface exploration to see how their trade-offs affect mission success. Using AR, users can inspect their 3D spacecraft and replay mission outcomes in real space.
details: Inspired by NASA’s Mars 2020 mission, our interactive game puts players aged 12 and older in the role of a Mars Mission Lead, guiding them through the real complexities of planning an interplanetary expedition. Through an intuitive five-step design flow, players choose a landing site on Mars, select a rover platform (Perseverance, Curiosity, or MER-class), equip scientific instruments, plot an orbital flight trajectory, and pick a suitable launch vehicle such as Atlas V, Delta IV, or SLS. Once the mission is configured, players launch a real-time simulation covering rocket liftoff, interplanetary cruise, Entry, Descent, and Landing, and surface exploration, watching how their engineering choices directly shape the mission’s outcome. Beyond the screen, an integrated Augmented Reality mode lets users project their custom 3D spacecraft into the real world and replay key mission phases right in front of them.
